children.text: The Indian American Artists Association (IAAA) is a 501(c)(3) entity whose purpose is to provide fund-raising and financial support for the arts programs, to promote and uplift Indian American artists, their art activities, and to raise community awareness of the Indian arts through art education.

Membership eligibility encompasses self-identified visual artists from the Indian subcontinent who work in 2D/3D mediums including painting, sketching, sculpture, digital art, photography, video art or mixed media and support IAAA's goals.

children.text: Support the Indian American Artists Association (IAAA) by making either recurring or one-time donation to IAAA securely through PayPal, using your credit card or bank account:
Indian American Artists Association would be honored to accept an in-memoriam gift from donors who find that a donation to the Association is an appropriate expression following a loss.
A donation can also be made as an expression of honoring someone you care about on a special occasion such as birthdays, retirements, weddings, anniversaries, or retirements.
To make a memorial or tribute gift as your donation, please send a notice of your memorial or tribute donation via an email to treasurer@indianamericanartists.org with the following information:
Memorial Gift: In Memory of (NAME), Address of individual receiving the notice
Tribute Gift: In Honor of (NAME) on (Name of special occasion)
Please make your check payable to Indian American Artists Association and mail to:
Indian American Artists Association, 1461 Edsel Dr, Milpitas, CA 95035
Please make a Zelle payment to artists.iaaa@gmail.com
Maximize your philanthropic impact if you have a charitable investment account through your investment broker. Find out more at:
What is a Donor Advised Fund
Many companies match charitable donations by their employees to encourage philanthropy. Find out whether your company will match a donation.
